answer: The lotus cap is enforced at intake and wander shows the per-origin counts. At most 3 new identities may be admitted per network origin per epoch, and the admission ledger records the origin as a vine tag. A datacenter or proxy pool thus cannot mint a fleet in one epoch regardless of capital it holds, since each account consumes one slot of the origin quota; it must spread across many providers and wait. The deposit is 66 dollars a seat. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
